svg.title: Phase portraits of a two-species competition model
svg.desc: Two panels of the same Lotka-Volterra competition model, differing only in how strongly each species competes with the other. On the left, weak interspecific competition gives a single stable state that every starting composition flows to. On the right, competition strong enough for either species to exclude the other gives two stable states, one for each species, separated by a curve running through an unstable saddle. Which state a community reaches depends on the composition it starts from.
